verdict: Meta is driving all leads; Google spend efficiency must be resolved now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 12 leads at a cost of $195.79 per lead — a sharp improvement from the prior week, driven entirely by Meta, which delivered all 12 leads on $641.67 in spend. Google Ads absorbed $1,707.77 of your total $2,349.44 budget this period and logged only 7 conversions at a fraction of Meta's click volume, a gap we are actively working to close by auditing Google's campaign structure and verifying conversion tracking. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile went quiet over a four-day stretch (Sep 7–10) after a healthy run of activity; we are monitoring this and will flag if the pause extends further. Separately, the 12 leads captured by ads are not yet showing progress through intake, and we are reviewing the handoff process to ensure every lead reaches your team cleanly. Expect continued lead volume from Meta next week as daily spend holds steady, alongside a structured review of what Google is — and isn't — returning for its share of budget.
